items.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Debuts PowerNexus MV UPS For AI Data Centers
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) introduced the PowerNexus MV UPS, a medium-voltage power system for AI data centers, focusing on grid integration and outdoor deployment. The PowerNexus MV UPS is designed for use with long-duration battery systems, targeting power-hungry AI compute clusters that strain existing electrical infrastructure. Vertiv plans a dedicated laboratory for PowerNexus MV UPS research and testing, with the goal of refining grid connectivity and outdoor performance for AI...
